names.zh: 注意网络任务 · 触屏变式提案

sourceEvidence.citation: Fan et al. (2002), Testing the Efficiency and Independence of Attentional Networks
sourceEvidence.readStatus: prior fixed research card; this design does not claim a new full-paper read

construct.claim: Conditions within this attempt; not direct brain network measurements or an ADHD/IQ/ability diagnosis.

difficulty.taskDemand: Central-arrow direction while ignoring flankers and spatial position; speeded left/right response.

practice.selection: Proposed saved-seed sample of 24 distinct cells from 48; actual marginals recorded; not a verified practice accuracy gate.
practice.feedback: Correct/error only; no RT feedback; incomplete/interrupted flow and repeat policy require confirmation.
practice.ruleProvenance: Source has SampleN(48-cell design,24); distinct saved-seed sampling is a project proposal, not an upstream persistence guarantee.

research.evidence: Matches fixed PEBL design count, not all Fan stimuli or device conditions.

experience.evidence: Project provisional short form; no reliability/equivalence evidence; no stable network ability inference.

protocol.durationNote: 4000 ms origin-to-origin rhythm; add instruction/calibration/breaks and completion overhead. Do not promise a 3-minute complete experience.
protocol.trialStartIntervalMeaning: Absolute next trial start deadline, not an additional 4000 ms ITI.

neutralProposal.status: USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED; different protocol variant if switched

inputProposal.touch: Fixed left/right zones below field, first valid pointerdown; target direction not target screen position.
inputProposal.pointer: Click the same fixed zones; actual input recorded.
inputProposal.keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight as proposed explicit mapping; auto layout is not copied as an implicit default.
inputProposal.extraEvents: Record premature, repeated, held-key and out-of-zone events; exact exclusion rule not yet frozen.

upstream.targetOffsetFormula: round(tan(1.06 degrees) * assumed eye distance in screen pixels)

project.physicalCalibration: Required proposal; reuse calibrated-unit method, not MOT's 12-degree geometry
project.warning: All preview geometry illustrative and uncalibrated; dimensions awaiting literature/display decision.

randomization.proposal: Saved seed, balanced formal 48-cell cycles, explicit block order, jitter schedule and realized sequence; versioned algorithm TBD

rawFieldProposal.timeoutNote: Timeout stays in accuracy denominator. Preserve actual deadline elapsed and source latency; absent response RT is null, not fabricated 0 or 1700.

metricDefinitions.formula: correct / technically usable formal trials in that condition; full count retained alongside separately identified technical exclusions
metricDefinitions.denominator: Includes wrong and timeout formal trials; practice excluded.
metricDefinitions.qualityGate: Hide affected conditions; no low-accuracy exclusion without explicit rule.

metricDefinitions.formula: Arithmetic mean of first accepted correct response latencies within the 1700ms window
metricDefinitions.denominator: Correct technically usable formal responses; wrong/timeout excluded from this RT mean but retained raw/accuracy.
metricDefinitions.nullWhen: No valid correct response; sufficiency rule not yet frozen

metricDefinitions.denominator: Show both marginal correct-response counts and planned counts
metricDefinitions.nullWhen: Either constituent condition unavailable or fails frozen precision/quality rule
metricDefinitions.qualityGate: Not a stable ability measure; short-form interpretation pending.

metricDefinitions.denominator: Separate correct-response counts for central and spatial_valid cues; each with planned count and technical exclusions.

metricDefinitions.qualityGate: Never convert to brain health/ability score.
metricDefinitions.denominator: Separate correct-response counts for incongruent and congruent flankers; each with planned count and technical exclusions.

analysis.publicDefault: Correct-only marginal RT plus corresponding accuracy/denominators; per-cell precision not implied.
analysis.auditComparison: Upstream all-trials RT summary may be retained as distinctly named research audit only, never silently merged.
analysis.blockSummary: Recompute each block from raw; upstream cumulative arrays must not be labeled independent per-block scores.
analysis.experiencePolicy: Each complete cell has only one trial. Proposed public feedback emphasizes actual marginal records; directional differences require separately frozen sufficiency/quality rules. No network ranking.

technical.decisions: Must be frozen with target devices; not invented from source flags.

theoretical.zeroDifference: Arithmetic equality this attempt; not a normal/abnormal cutoff.

literatureExperience.note: Source research supports paradigm comparison; no project-specific norms or ability cutoffs.

projectProvisional.reviewCondition: Protocol/input/geometry and real device study before release.

states.interpretable: Only approved metrics with all required constituent conditions sufficient.
states.limited: Affected metrics/aggregate hidden; unaffected descriptive records may remain.
states.invalid: No performance conclusion; friendly state and next choices.

code.upstreamLicense: GPL-2.0 recorded, scope/integration must be reviewed if code copied
code.proposed: Original project implementation; no upstream code copied in this static preview

stimuli.proposed: Original geometric SVG arrows/fixation/cue shapes; no external pictures or bundled fonts

licensing.rightsDisposition: Clearance route and implementation strategy kept separate; no blanket commercial claim.
licensing.trademark: EDUK12.TOP only in optional report image; not timed stimulus

stimulus.basis: Fixed PEBL current source uses white/black; not its outdated grey comment.

versionImpact.assessment: Neutral form, geometry, input, jitter/response semantics and practice policy affect protocol identity; freeze after user confirmation.
versionImpact.parameters: Profiles/config hashes and QC rules independently bind; no normVersion invented; norms absent.
versionImpact.report: Report/presentation can evolve independently; changing denominator/aggregation is semantic.
versionImpact.currentVersionAssignment: Design revision only; no product engine/scorer/config version reserved or release compatibility claimed.

decisionsPending: PEBL neutral no-flanker vs Fan horizontal dashes

Fixed response-zone placement/size and explicit keyboard mapping
48-trial experience balance and burden; practice repeats/interruption handling
Correct-only public metric definitions plus minimal correct counts/quality thresholds
Real device timing, Chinese/English understanding and population suitability
Native platform admission/frozen tuples/FINAL/report/export and device metadata consumers

resourceAndPlatform.client: Seeded presentation and performance clock locally; no per-frame HTTP/DB writes.
resourceAndPlatform.storage: Key trial responses/QC summaries for DB; full bounded frame/event data for approved COS full archive, platform contract pending.
